# satisfactory_belt (Resource)

A conveyor belt between two factory connectors. Every change replaces it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "satisfactory_belt" "ingots" {
  class          = "Build_ConveyorBeltMk1_C"
  from_id        = satisfactory_building.smelter.id
  from_connector = 1 # smelter output
  to_id          = satisfactory_building.constructor.id
  to_connector   = 0 # constructor input
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `class` (String) Belt class, Build_ConveyorBeltMk1_C through Build_ConveyorBeltMk6_C.
- `from_connector` (Number) Zero-based connector index on the source buildable.
- `from_id` (String) id of the buildable the source end attaches to.
- `to_connector` (Number) Zero-based connector index on the destination buildable.
- `to_id` (String) id of the buildable the destination end attaches to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform-assigned stable ID, persisted in the save game by the mod.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the resource's tf_id (the UUID the mod persists in the save).
terraform import satisfactory_belt.ingots "0a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-ef0123456789"
```
